title: Hand off and insert a duplex fibre connector
instruction: The right arm passes the cable-bound blue duplex SC connector to the left arm. The left arm must secure it before the right arm releases and retreats. Then insert the connector fully into the adapter port, release it, and retreat.
context: At a fibre service bench, the free end of a transceiver-terminated lead must be handed between arms and seated in a keyed duplex coupler while its attached cable remains constrained by the fixed transceiver. This task evaluates retention through the handoff as well as aligned insertion of the SC end.
setup: Fixed station-table layout; zero object jitter; run seed 0. Objects: upright PCIe network-card upper section (about 21 x 121 x 65 mm collider envelope; green PCB, steel port cages) on a 140 x 150 x 6 mm steel foot and 6 x 120 x 24 mm steel backplate; gold SFP module (47.3 x 13.75 x 8.6 mm, 20 g) fixed in the nearer cage. Blue polymer duplex SC plug (25.97 x 25 x 10.1 mm envelope, 40 g) starts flat on the table, with its tip facing the adapter and 25 mm from the mouth. Yellow polymer-jacketed fibre cable (2.5 mm radius, 12 g) joins the plug to the fixed SFP module and is simulated as 20 mm flexible segments. Silver duplex SC adapter (48.6 x 27.4 x 9.3 mm envelope; modelled with rigid collision shapes) stands on a 34 x 30 x 40.3 mm steel pedestal and an 80 x 60 x 6 mm steel base; its keyed opening faces the left arm. Both YAM arms start in their ready poses. Exact collider geometry and world poses are in this task's scene and geometry files.
scoring: No insertion credit until transfer is demonstrated. Both TCPs must be within 40 mm of the plug with both grippers closed; after the right-arm donor opens and retreats beyond 40 mm, the left-arm receiver must remain closed and near the plug, then move at least 8 mm while the plug follows within 4 mm. This checks retention after transfer. Thereafter, insertion scores 0.25 at 2 mm, 0.5 at 6 mm and 1.0 at 11 mm tip depth past the adapter mouth. The tip must remain within 1 mm of the port centreline and roll within 5 degrees; tilt may be at most 10 degrees for partial credit and 3 degrees for full credit. Success requires full score and plug speed below 0.03 m/s through the demonstrated 20-second post-release hold.
reset_notes: Return the SC connector to its marked starting pose, with the cable draped along the recorded setup. The SFP end remains fixed in the card port.
fidelity: The connector and adapter use simplified collision boxes based on public duplex SC models. The simulation omits optical function and connector latch details. The flexible cable is a chain of rigid segments with bending joints. The SFP end is fixed so the task focuses on two-arm transfer and connector insertion.
scores: Dream-1 trial: incomplete (stopped after 425 steps following repeated expired-session responses; no final score reported); scripted handoff demo: 1.0 (1,467 steps; 22-second post-release hold, recorded before the latest scorer gate)
